name: Reflex Arc Neural Pathway
semanticDescription: Medical-grade 3D neural pathway model of a somatic reflex arc conforming to NCERT Class 10 (Ch 7, Fig 7.2). Features detailed hot saucepan stimulus, human finger receptor with dermal pain endings, afferent sensory nerve tract with dorsal root ganglion (DRG) entering the dorsal nerve root, spinal cord transverse section with anterior median fissure and posterior median sulcus, white matter, butterfly gray matter with slender dorsal horns and broad ventral horns, central canal with ependymal lining, interneuron (relay neuron) with ascending collateral axon ('Message to brain'), efferent motor nerve tract exiting via ventral root with impulse chevrons, and anatomical fusiform arm flexor muscle with tendons and neuromuscular end-plates. Features dual presentation collections (ReflexArc_Full and ReflexArc_Section).
simplifications: Nerve pathways shown as continuous color-coded axon fiber bundles with directional impulse indicators.
Spinal cord segment displayed in anatomical transverse cross-section.
